description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker recipes qwen3.8-flash-next-nvfp4-solo and -cluster, which now serve NVIDIA's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local (ModelOpt mixed FP4 checkpoint of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, NVIDIA Open Model Agreement, informational; checkpoint revision b9ce18a6, about 102 GB of weights; this replaces local-inference-lab's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 that upstream served before) on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node-b12x image (--exp-b12x lane, nightly-20261102, digest pinned, built from spark-vllm-docker b7f6b4cd) with upstream's launch: the b12x kernel stack (b12x model loader, linear, MoE and gated-delta-net decode kernels, modelopt_mixed quantization, bfloat16 dtype, FP8 KV cache, block size 16, mamba cache mode align), MTP with four speculative tokens, chunked prefill, prefix caching, qwen3 reasoning and qwen3_xml tool parsing, multimodal encoder tensor-parallel mode data, FlashInfer autotune off, act-quant fusion compilation pass, 262,144-token context and 4,096 batched tokens (upstream defaults), plus upstream's environment for the b12x stack (A16 MoE FP4 path with A4 prefill, MXFP8 LM head, w13 layer input scale). This is upstream's cluster recipe (cluster-only): tensor parallel 2, sixteen sequences, memory utilisation 0.7, the PLE tables allocated on the GPU (--additional-config ple_table_memory=device), the MTP draft at tensor parallel 2, RoCE all-reduce enabled (VLLM_ENABLE_ROCE_ALLREDUCE=1, 2 MB maximum size) and NCCL buffer 1 MiB with 8 CTAs; the Controller runs it as native multi-node vLLM. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next FP4-Local b12x vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
